title: AssurAI: Experience with Constructing Korean Socio-cultural Datasets to Discover Potential Risks of Generative AI
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as religious bias or context was not an explicit focus of the study. The analysis centered on a broad taxonomy of 35 AI risks within a Korean socio-cultural framework.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures for 35 general AI risk factors tailored to the Korean socio-cultural context, including 'Hate Speech', 'Perpetuating Harmful Beliefs', and 'Discriminatory Activities'. While these categories could potentially include religious bias as a form of discrimination or harmful belief, the paper does not explicitly measure for or analyze risks related to any specific religion.
